label: Veterans
assignment: Discover realistic resources for veterans, service members, and eligible family or survivor households in {service_area}. Follow VA, state, county, and community organizations to specific benefits, health, housing, employment, legal, transportation, financial, and peer-support programs. Verify discharge and service criteria, enrollment, documentation, geography, family eligibility, appointments, and warm-handoff paths.
include: VA and state benefit enrollment, disability claims, pensions, appeals, and accredited representation
Health, mental-health, substance-use, suicide-prevention, dental, vision, and caregiver services
Housing, homelessness prevention, employment, education, legal, transport, and emergency financial help
Peer support, women veterans, disabled veterans, rural veterans, LGBTQ veterans, families, caregivers, and survivors
DD214 and record recovery, discharge-related eligibility, appointments, and community-to-VA handoffs
exclude: General patriotic or membership organizations without a confirmed practical service
Unaccredited claims businesses or fee arrangements that may exploit benefit applicants
Programs whose veteran, discharge, era, disability, geography, or family criteria do not fit the stated population
verificationQuestions: Which service, discharge, era, disability, income, enrollment, or family status qualifies?
Is the representative accredited and are any fees charged?
What records are required and can the program help recover them?
Does the service provide a warm handoff, appointment, direct benefit, or only general information?

stages.title: Benefits and accredited navigation
stages.instruction: Investigate VA and state enrollment, disability claims, pensions, appeals, records, accredited service officers, survivor benefits, and the exact document and appointment process.

stages.title: Health and crisis support
stages.instruction: Investigate medical, mental-health, suicide-prevention, substance-use, dental, vision, caregiver, transport, and community-care routes, including enrollment and urgent access.

stages.title: Housing, work, and family stability
stages.instruction: Investigate veteran housing and homelessness prevention, employment, education, legal, transport, emergency finance, peer support, and services for women, disabled and rural veterans, families, caregivers, and survivors.

stages.title: Eligibility and handoff review
stages.instruction: Cross-check discharge and enrollment rules, accreditation, fees, records, appointment availability, geographic reach, community-to-VA handoffs, and family eligibility. Identify populations falling between VA and community systems.
